title: Constitution of Benches by the President

content.scenario: The President of the National Commission constitutes a Bench with one member to hear a complaint regarding a defective product, citing the need for specialized expertise. The complainant, a consumer from Mumbai, had purchased a smartphone that stopped working within a month of purchase.
content.outcome: The Bench, presided over by the single member, has the jurisdiction, powers, and authority to hear the complaint, as per the provision that allows the President to constitute a Bench with one or more members. The senior-most member of the Bench, in this case, the single member, will preside over the Bench.

user_queries: Can the President constitute a Bench with one member?
What are the powers of a Bench constituted by the President?
How is the jurisdiction of the National Commission exercised?
